'''Varus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] archivist living on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] he asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agent to venture into [[Tarlam]] city archives occupied by the [[InterStellar Regulators]] and retrieve the [[Shipwright's Tools]] - a relic made by the first colonists who settled on the planet from the material dismantled from their ships.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Archivist Varus appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, released on [[April 9]], [[2013]].
